	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

func TestBuildS5DeterministicActionTurnUsesLocalReceiptCommandNotDialogV2(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	const (
		studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		teacherID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
		dialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		promptID  = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
		messageID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
		receiptID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
		jobID     = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
		eventID   = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	)
	body, ui, err := BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepDirection, "ru", 0)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	binding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(TeacherDialogBinding{ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: LearningContextGeneral})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	prompt := DialogMessage{ID: promptID, DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: DialogMessageChannelWeb,
		PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, Body: body, AssistantUI: ui, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: now}
	interaction, err := NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, prompt, OnboardingStepDirection, 0, 0, 1, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	action := AssistantUIActionRequest{Schema: AssistantUIActionSchema, DialogID: dialogID, MessageID: promptID, MessageVersion: 1,
		BlockID: "onboarding.direction.d0.v1", ActionID: "direction.backend", IdempotencyKey: receiptID}
	receipt, err := NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(action, studentID, teacherID, "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", now, now.Add(time.Minute), OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	receipt.Status = OnboardingReceiptMaterialized
	receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID = messageID
	receipt.ClaimToken, receipt.LockedUntil, receipt.CompletedAt = "", nil, &now
	receipt, err = NormalizeOnboardingActionReceipt(receipt)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	interaction.State = TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved
	interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID = jobID
	interaction.ReservedActionReceiptID = receiptID
	interaction.ReservationMode = TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction
	interaction, err = NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	job := TeacherDialogJob{TeacherJobID: jobID, Request: DialogTeacherRequest{
		SchemaVersion: 2, EventID: eventID, DialogID: dialogID, EventSequence: 2, TeacherTurnSequence: 1,
		SourceMessageID: messageID, SourceSequence: 2, SourceMessageVersion: 1, ReplyToMessageID: promptID,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: messageID, CorrelationID: receiptID, DialogCausationID: messageID, CausationID: eventID,
		ActionReceiptID: receiptID, // StudentCommandID intentionally absent from Dialog v2.
		SourceChannel:   DialogMessageChannelWeb, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: LearningContextGeneral, OccurredAt: now,
	}}

	command, hasEffect, err := BuildS5DeterministicActionTurn(job, interaction, receipt)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, hasEffect)
	require.Equal(t, receipt.StudentCommandID, command.StudentCommandID)
	require.NotEmpty(t, command.StudentCommandID)
	require.Empty(t, job.Request.StudentCommandID)
}

func TestOnboardingInteractionRequiresExplicitSupportedSessionVersion(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 12, 6, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	binding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(TeacherDialogBinding{
		ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		PersonalTeacherID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", ContextType: LearningContextGeneral,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	body, ui, err := BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepDirection, "en", 0)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	prompt := DialogMessage{ID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", DialogID: binding.ID,
		AuthorType: DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: binding.PersonalTeacherID,
		Body: body, AssistantUI: ui, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: now}
	for _, version := range []int{0, 4} {
		_, err = NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, prompt, OnboardingStepDirection, 0, 0, version, now)
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding)
	}
	v1, err := NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, prompt, OnboardingStepDirection, 0, 0, 1, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	v3, err := NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, prompt, OnboardingStepDirection, 0, 0, 3, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEqual(t, v1.ID, v3.ID)
}

func TestS5ResponsePromptInteractionRequiresExactDialogReplyAnchor(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 16, 30, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	const (
		studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		teacherID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
		dialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		sourceID  = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
		promptID  = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
	)
	binding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(TeacherDialogBinding{ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: LearningContextGeneral})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	body, ui, err := BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepExperience, "ru", 1)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	message := DialogMessage{ID: promptID, DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: DialogMessageChannelWeb,
		PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ReplyToMessageID: sourceID, Body: body, AssistantUI: ui, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 3, LastEventSequence: 3, CreatedAt: now}

	interaction, err := NewS5OnboardingInteractionForResponse(binding, message, sourceID, OnboardingStepExperience, 1, 0, 1, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, promptID, interaction.PromptMessageID)

	_, err = NewS5OnboardingInteractionForResponse(binding, message, "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", OnboardingStepExperience, 1, 0, 1, now)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding)
}

func TestS5SemanticDecisionStoresOnlySelectedOperationalProjection(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 13, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	const (
		studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		teacherID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
		dialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		promptID  = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	)
	body, ui, err := BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepExperience, "ru", 1)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	binding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(TeacherDialogBinding{ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: LearningContextGeneral})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	interaction, err := NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, DialogMessage{ID: promptID, DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, Body: body, AssistantUI: ui, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: now}, OnboardingStepExperience, 1, 0, 1, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	result, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
		Schema: TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "This raw provider wording must never enter teacher_onboarding_turn.",
		SlotCandidates: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{{Slot: TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, CodeValue: "basic", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9000}},
		Questions:      []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	decision, err := NewTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(result, interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(decision)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	stored := string(encoded)
	require.Contains(t, stored, "self_assessed_experience")
	require.NotContains(t, stored, "This raw provider wording")
	require.NotContains(t, stored, "result")
	require.False(t, strings.Contains(stored, "provider wording"))
}

func TestS5ConfirmationPromptDoesNotPromiseFinalization(t *testing.T) {
	for locale, expected := range map[string]string{
		"ru": "Подтвердить и сохранить этот ответ.",
		"en": "Confirm and save this answer.",
	} {
		t.Run(locale, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, ui, err := BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepConfirmation, locale, 3)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Contains(t, string(ui), expected)
			require.NotContains(t, string(ui), "finish onboarding")
			require.NotContains(t, string(ui), "завершить онбординг")
		})
	}
}

func TestS5ConfirmedHighImpactProposalBecomesOneExplicitUICommand(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 15, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	const (
		studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		teacherID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
		dialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		promptID  = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
		messageID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
		receiptID = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
		jobID     = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
		eventID   = "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888"
	)
	binding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(TeacherDialogBinding{ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: LearningContextGeneral})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
		Schema: TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "",
		SlotCandidates: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{{Slot: TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, CodeValue: "backend", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9000}},
		Questions:      []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
	})
	require.Error(t, err, "semantic result requires user-visible text")
	// The decision constructor receives a valid S4 result; its text is dropped
	// immediately and never becomes part of the operational projection.
	result, err := NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{
		Schema: TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "I can confirm this direction.",
		SlotCandidates: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{{Slot: TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, CodeValue: "backend", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9000}},
		Questions:      []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{},
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	placeholderBody, placeholderUI, err := BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepDirection, "ru", 0)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	seedInteraction, err := NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, DialogMessage{ID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, Body: placeholderBody, AssistantUI: placeholderUI, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: now}, OnboardingStepDirection, 0, 0, 1, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	decision, err := NewTeacherOnboardingSemanticDecision(result, seedInteraction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	confirmationBody, confirmationUI, err := BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepConfirmation, "ru", 0)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	interaction, err := NewS5ConfirmationInteraction(binding, DialogMessage{ID: promptID, DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: DialogMessageChannelWeb, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, Body: confirmationBody, AssistantUI: confirmationUI, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: now}, decision, 0, 0, 1, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	action := AssistantUIActionRequest{Schema: AssistantUIActionSchema, DialogID: dialogID, MessageID: promptID, MessageVersion: 1, BlockID: "onboarding.confirmation.d0.v1", ActionID: "confirmation.confirm", IdempotencyKey: receiptID}
	receipt, err := NewOnboardingActionReceiptForMode(action, studentID, teacherID, "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", now, now.Add(time.Minute), OnboardingActionExecutionCanonical)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	receipt.Status, receipt.CanonicalStudentMessageID, receipt.ClaimToken, receipt.LockedUntil, receipt.CompletedAt = OnboardingReceiptMaterialized, messageID, "", nil, &now
	receipt, err = NormalizeOnboardingActionReceipt(receipt)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	interaction.State, interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID, interaction.ReservedActionReceiptID, interaction.ReservationMode = TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved, jobID, receiptID, TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction
	interaction, err = NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	job := TeacherDialogJob{TeacherJobID: jobID, Request: DialogTeacherRequest{SchemaVersion: 2, EventID: eventID, DialogID: dialogID, EventSequence: 3, TeacherTurnSequence: 1, SourceMessageID: messageID, SourceSequence: 3, SourceMessageVersion: 1, ReplyToMessageID: promptID, CanonicalStudentMessageID: messageID, CorrelationID: receiptID, DialogCausationID: messageID, CausationID: eventID, ActionReceiptID: receiptID, SourceChannel: DialogMessageChannelWeb, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: LearningContextGeneral, OccurredAt: now}}
	command, hasEffect, err := BuildS5ConfirmedProposalTurn(job, interaction, receipt, decision)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, hasEffect)
	require.False(t, command.FinalizeCurrentV1)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection, command.Slots[0].SlotCode)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherStudentTurnExplicitUI, command.Slots[0].Origin)
	require.Equal(t, "backend", *command.Slots[0].CodeValue)
}

func TestS5TextSemanticCandidateCanOnlyMutateCurrentLowRiskInteraction(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 10, 13, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	const (
		studentID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
		teacherID = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
		dialogID  = "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
		promptID  = "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
		messageID = "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555"
		jobID     = "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666"
		eventID   = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	)
	direction := "backend"
	state := TeacherStudentOnboardingState{Schema: TeacherStudentOnboardingStateSchema, ProfileVersion: 0, Draft: StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: studentID, Status: StudentOnboardingDraftDraft,
		StudentOnboardingAnswers: StudentOnboardingAnswers{DirectionCode: &direction}, Version: 1, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now,
	}}
	body, ui, err := BuildTeacherOnboardingPrompt(OnboardingStepExperience, "ru", 1)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	binding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(TeacherDialogBinding{ID: dialogID, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: LearningContextGeneral})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	prompt := DialogMessage{ID: promptID, DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: DialogMessageChannelWeb,
		PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, Body: body, AssistantUI: ui, Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 1, LastEventSequence: 1, CreatedAt: now}
	interaction, err := NewS5OnboardingInteraction(binding, prompt, OnboardingStepExperience, 1, 0, 1, now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	interaction.State, interaction.ReservedTeacherJobID, interaction.ReservationMode = TeacherOnboardingInteractionReserved, jobID, TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText
	interaction, err = NormalizeTeacherOnboardingInteraction(interaction)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	job := TeacherDialogJob{TeacherJobID: jobID, Request: DialogTeacherRequest{
		SchemaVersion: 2, EventID: eventID, DialogID: dialogID, EventSequence: 2, TeacherTurnSequence: 1,
		SourceMessageID: messageID, SourceSequence: 2, SourceMessageVersion: 1, ReplyToMessageID: promptID,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: messageID, CorrelationID: messageID, DialogCausationID: messageID, CausationID: eventID,
		SourceChannel: DialogMessageChannelWeb, StudentID: studentID, PersonalTeacherID: teacherID, ContextType: LearningContextGeneral, OccurredAt: now,
	}}
	turn, err := NewTeacherOnboardingTurn(TeacherOnboardingTurn{TeacherJobID: jobID, SourceEventID: eventID, InteractionID: interaction.ID,
		Mode: TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText, Stage: TeacherOnboardingTurnAIStaged, CausalAIExecutionID: DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-ai", jobID),
		StudentCommandID: DeterministicOnboardingUUID("semantic-student", jobID), ResponseCommandID: DeterministicOnboardingUUID("response", jobID),
		StudentEffectState: TeacherOnboardingEffectNotAttempted, CreatedAt: now, UpdatedAt: now})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	source := DialogMessage{ID: messageID, DialogID: dialogID, AuthorType: DialogMessageAuthorUser, Channel: DialogMessageChannelWeb, SenderID: studentID,
		ReplyToMessageID: promptID, Body: "Я немного знаю основы", Status: 1, Version: 1, MessageSequence: 2, LastEventSequence: 2, CreatedAt: now}
	request, err := BuildS5TextSemanticRequest(job, turn, interaction, state, source, prompt)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, turn.CausalAIExecutionID, request.AIExecutionID)
	require.Empty(t, request.Variables.OnboardingState.AcceptedSlots, "Teacher must not invent Student provenance")
	require.Equal(t, []string{string(TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience)}, request.Variables.OnboardingState.ActiveInteraction.ExpectedSlots)

	result := TeacherOnboardingSemanticResult{Schema: TeacherOnboardingSemanticSchemaCode, Response: "Понял, зафиксирую базовый уровень.",
		SlotCandidates: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticCandidate{{Slot: TeacherOnboardingSlotExperience, CodeValue: "basic", StringListValue: []string{}, ConfidenceBasisPoints: 9000}},
		Questions:      []TeacherOnboardingSemanticQuestion{}, Uncertainties: []TeacherOnboardingSemanticUncertainty{}}
	result, err = NormalizeTeacherOnboardingSemanticResult(result)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	candidate, accepted := SelectS5TextMutation(result, interaction)
	require.True(t, accepted)
	command, err := BuildS5InterpretedTextTurn(job, turn, interaction, candidate)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Nil(t, command.ActionReceiptID)
	require.NotNil(t, command.AIExecutionID)
	require.Equal(t, turn.CausalAIExecutionID, *command.AIExecutionID)
	require.Equal(t, TeacherStudentTurnExplicitText, command.Slots[0].Origin)

	result.SlotCandidates[0].Slot = TeacherOnboardingSlotDirection
	_, accepted = SelectS5TextMutation(result, interaction)
	require.False(t, accepted, "high-impact or off-slot candidates are response-only")
}
